en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large European-style public square with formal gardens, benches and a central columnar monument surrounded by a fountain or plinth. Historic multi‑storey buildings with ornate façades line the square, including a tall clock/bell tower on the left and a domed-roof corner building. Cars, a bus and pedestrians are visible, suggesting a mid‑20th‑century scene. The reverse side has printed and handwritten Hungarian text, a Hungarian postage stamp and address lines.
